what_changed: The Fed raised rates for the first time in years with a unanimous vote under Warsh, yet yields dipped and tech led a higher close. WTI eased to 102.4 (-3.2% on the day) as the market sees the Saudi pipeline outage as less disruptive than feared. Jensen Huang said Nvidia will sell twice as many chips next year.

oil_gas.why: The Iran war and Saudi supply shock keep crude above 100 while XOM lags; no exit trigger yet, but the outage is now seen as less severe.

gold_miners.why: The Fed hiked instead of pausing; yields near 5% and a firmer dollar weigh on gold.

chips.why: Huang's 'twice as many chips next year' guidance and investors returning to AI stocks; NVDA is still 9% below its high.

copper_uranium.why: No copper outage; the US-Niger uranium investment leans bearish for supply.
